svg.title: Pundoku — D4 foreground layers for Icon Composer
svg.desc: Production layers. Flat, opaque, full white, transparent background, no platform mask, no baked shadows/blurs/highlights — the system draws specular highlights and refraction (app-icons.md › Visual effects). Three groups to split into three layers: #cellA and #cellB at ~46 % opacity, #core at ~50 % on top. Background gradient is defined inside Icon Composer (see pd98-logo-round3.md § layers). Dropping #core is the sanctioned simplification.
